findings.title: clustering needs at least two payments by one payer
findings.note: this run made a single payment; with one payment there is no pair to cluster

findings.title: the wallet layer was never told to relax its privacy policy
evidence: wallet call: propose_shielding_coinbase with default spend policy (no AllowRevealedAmounts, no AllowLinkingAccountAddresses, no AllowFullyTransparent)

findings.title: one payment, one fresh diversified Orchard receiver
evidence: invoice 4471 -> uregtest106rqhh28qq6fhdtay885kgugvq9f7sncurjhnkq5z75gu0km9jvgedvvfj093gwkx4egted9q8j82ezwhjjcqv94l2ky8694kyck5c80 (no earlier payment in this run shares it)

findings.title: the payment path is Orchard-only; no transparent address is accepted or produced by it
evidence: payment 295e61d6e0e5b43b5ab4f60466f021d4f5f602eae5db425f9e35375099c712bf has exactly one shielded output and no transparent output
coinbase funding is rig infrastructure, recorded in `funding`, not a path the flow offers

findings.title: value moved into the shielded pool; none left it
evidence: tx 295e61d6e0e5b43b5ab4f60466f021d4f5f602eae5db425f9e35375099c712bf: 25.0000 ZEC transparent in -> 24.9997 ZEC Orchard out (fee 0.0003)
pool totals @261: transparent 160625030000 zat, orchard 2499970000 zat

findings.title: payment amount echoes a public funding amount: four 6.25 ZEC coinbase inputs, 24.9975 ZEC output
evidence: funding: 4 x 625000000 zat, each a public coinbase output to tmF1xjfhsSzhy55dmhorzTnKjtHhZmPKzts
match type: exact round multiple of a public funding amount
findings.note: on a public chain the multiset of funding amounts would already be visible; on mainnet, fund the flow from a larger anonymity set or vary the funding amounts

findings.title: invoice 4471 is bound to its payment in a shielded memo a verifier can recompute
the memo carries an invoice id and a receipt seed, nothing permanent and personal
evidence: memo bytes decode to ASCII invoice id + receipt seed; no email, phone, name, or free text beyond the structured record

findings.title: funding and spending never share a block
the simulated merchant received the invoice id and the txid, and nothing that identifies the payer
evidence: POST /webhook/invoice/4471 fields: invoice_id, txid; no identity field, no remote_ip recorded
findings.note: merchant side was simulated by the rig; this is what the rig's own merchant observed, stated as such

findings.title: no repeat spend/funding pattern to correlate in this run
findings.note: one payment, delay to nearest preceding inflow is 100 blocks; the correlation window is not exercised

findings.title: no receipt or report artifact was exported by this run
findings.note: nothing to inspect for excess disclosure
